headline: Transfer rumors, news: Arsenal want Yildiz as Al Hilal add Martinelli to short list
description: Arsenal are looking into the possibility of signing Kenan Yildiz from Juventus. Transfer Talk has the latest.

headline: Premier League live updates: Arsenal kick off season against Coventry
description: The 2026-27 Premier League season begins as defending champions Arsenal take on newly promoted Coventry City.

headline: Ezri Konsa joins Premier League champions Arsenal from Aston Villa
description: Ezri Konsa has joined Arsenal from Aston Villa, the club has confirmed.

headline: Unai Emery: Ollie Watkins, Emiliano Martinez could leave Aston Villa
description: Aston Villa boss Unai Emery admits Ollie Watkins could be the next big-name player to leave the club this summer, while also revealing Emiliano Martínez has asked to move.

headline: Roberto De Zerbi confirms Micky van de Ven as new Tottenham captain
description: Roberto De Zerbi has confirmed Micky van de Ven is Tottenham's new captain.

headline: Enzo Maresca: Jérémy Doku will miss Man City's Premier League opener
description: Manchester City winger Jérémy Doku will miss their Premier League opener against Bournemouth with a calf injury, manager Enzo Maresca has confirmed.
